result.summary: Refactors transaction construction in fee estimator unit tests to initialize inputs and outputs directly using constructors and initializer lists instead of mutating templates and resizing vectors. In blockpolicyestimator_tests, deduplicates repeated logic that builds mempool entries and submits transactions to the estimator into an add_tx helper lambda.
result.problem: Fee estimator unit tests construct test transactions imperatively through vector resizes and field-by-field mutations, and blockpolicyestimator_tests repeats identical transaction submission boilerplate across three separate test loops.
evidence: Part of #36692 (issue: 'Declarative construction of test data')
result.changed_since_previous: No functional differences from the previous version; rebased or minor adjustment.
result.card: This PR refactors unit test transaction setup in blockpolicyestimator_tests and mempool_fee_estimator_tests to use direct constructor calls and initializer lists rather than mutating templates and resizing vectors. It also extracts repeated fee estimator submission boilerplate into an add_tx helper lambda. The change is part of tracking issue #36692 for declarative test data construction, with no behavior change.

risk.why: Touches only unit tests for fee estimation; any bug would cause test failures without affecting production code.
